We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Dutch-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: structured follow-ups and clean CRM hygiene

 * Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Dutch; strong English. German is a big plus

 * Ready for a paid temporary relocation (around 2 months in Vienna to soak up our culture)

What We Offer

 * €70.000-€120.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy

 * Regular team offsites

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

1 Technical GEO Growth Specialist (f/m/d) - full-time Own our GEO strategy

The goal is to make Walls.io the primary source AI engines actually cite for social media feeds, social APIs, UGC, and event marketing. You'll create E-E-A-T-driven content to build our brand presence and topical authority across LLMs and track our brand's share of voice.

Search and AI visibility don't stop at our own site. Where it moves the needle, you can build presence on platforms that shape both organic discovery and how LLMs perceive us: YouTube as a search engine in its own right and Reddit or LinkedIn strategies that feed brand authority and GEO. You decide which channels are worth the effort.

Run GEO growth experiments

Every month, you'll propose, launch, and test a mini project outside your day-to-day: a new channel, content format, tool, or tactic, with success criteria defined upfront and measured throughout.

Manage SEO

Your day-to-day work covers a wide range of SEO topics, from discovering new search terms and building links to updating existing content and conducting regular technical SEO audits.

Automate

You automate before you're asked to. Audits, keyword research, competitor tracking, and reporting run on scripts, AI agents, or workflows you built, not manual pulls from GSC, Ahrefs, or PostHog every week.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, you've set baselines and launched your first experiments. Over the following quarter, qualified signups and demo requests from organic channels are trending clearly upward, our LLM share of voice is climbing against competitors, and your core reporting and audits run automatically instead of by hand.

Requirements
Who you are

 * Experience: minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, preferably within SaaS. You understand how LLM-generated answers work.
 * Proven track record: Experience in increasing organic traffic and generating business for a SaaS product.
 * Skills: Strong communication skills. Exceptional written and spoken English. Technical background so you can read HTML/CSS/JS, reason about crawlability, publish mini websites independently, and write technical specs for developers when needed.
 * You use AI every day. You've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT way beyond the chatbox. You already automate tasks like reporting, data analysis, audits, and content creation, focusing on outstanding results, no slop.
 * Initiative is at the heart of this role. You must proactively identify opportunities or challenges and take action to address them without waiting for direction. We're looking for a test-and-learn mindset.

Our offer
You will work in a centrally located office with a lot of natural light and space in a renovated factory building. There's a fully equipped kitchen with big dining tables, sound-proofed phone/video call booths, meeting and focus rooms, and a relaxation area.

 * A collaborative and supportive international team that values open communication and teamwork.
 * Hybrid work: A balance of home and office days
 * Personal budget for education, conferences, literature, ...
 * Free public transport card for Vienna's excellent network
 * Fun team activities
 * An inclusive work environment that fosters professional growth and development
 * Full access to paid AI tooling: Claude, ChatGPT, whatever you need
 * Company 100% owned by the original founder

Additional Information

 * Position: Full-time (38.5 hours/week) based in Vienna.
 * Salary: Based on your qualifications and experience, we offer a salary between EUR 55,000 and 70,000 gross annually (split over 14 salaries/year).
 * Start Date: Flexible

Hiring timeline
Send us your CV, your portfolio, and either a short note or a 1-minute video on why this role is an excellent fit for you, via e-mail at walls.technicalgeogrowthspecialist@applynow.io or the application form under the following link:

ENPULSION GmbH is a Space Tech company based in ... 1 Electrical Engineer (w/m/d) Job Overview:
ENPULSION is looking for an Electrical Engineer (f/m/x) to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and integration of high-reliability electronic systems for spacecraft electric propulsion products. You will be working closely with cross-functional teams, and you will ensure robust, compliant, and high-performance electrical architectures while driving continuous technical improvement and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

 * Design of circuits and PCBs for miniaturized high-voltage power supplies, including digital, analog, and high-voltage subsystems.
 * Perform reliability and worst-case analyses to ensure robust and high-performance operation.
 * Establish and maintain comprehensive technical documentation and design records.
 * Support EEE component selection, qualification, procurement, and coordination with external suppliers.
 * Develop test procedures, verification plans, and dedicated test setups.
 * Collaborate closely with the production team to prepare and optimize series production.
 * Interface with customers and contribute to technical discussions and reviews.
 * Work in an agile development environment in close cooperation with the engineering team.

Your profile:
 * Academic education in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering or similar. 
 * Professional experience of 2-5 years related to high reliability electronics or 7+ years in digital and analog electronics design. 
 * Understanding of and experience in the aerospace, automotive, rail, medical, nuclear or defense industry is required. 
 * Experience with high reliability electronics and applicable standards.
 * Experience with electronics documentation and analysis.
 * Knowledge of DC/DC inverter topologies and magnetics (trafo and coil) sizing.
 * Experience in developing complete electronic unit considering mechanical and thermal constraints.
 * Microprocessor ATmega and ARM know-how.
 * Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week 

Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 3.893,09 gross per month on a full-time basis (38.5 h/week), with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Why us?
At ENPULSION, you'll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include: 

 * 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
 * Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a discounted parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
 * Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options
 * Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
 * Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
 * Firmenradl - Bike Leasing program
 * Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
 ** FitFabrik Fitness Center
 ** Airport Health Center
 ** Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
 ** VIE Community App for news and deals

ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone and supports diversity and inclusion. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply.
